title: ふた色の磁石庭
concept: 二つの大きな磁石を動かすと、符号の違う粒が集まり、同じ粒は離れていく。極を替えるたびに塊がほどけ、押し合って別の輪郭になる。正解や得点を置かず、気に入る流れと形を見つけて一枚の標本にする庭。
howToPlay: 大きな磁石をドラッグし、短くタップすると極が替わる。粒は同符号から離れ異符号へ集まる。好きな形になったら標本ボタンで区切る。
libraryDecision: Matter.jsを使い、粒同士が重ならず押し合う密度を加える。磁石の力だけでは一つの点に集まるため、衝突で塊の輪郭が生まれるよう核を強めた。36粒・二磁石に絞り、3Dは使わない。
soundDecision: 磁石をつかむ時は低い短音、極の切替は二つの高さ、標本の完成は高い音で返す。粒の細かな衝突音やBGMは鳴らさず、動きの観察を妨げない。

candidates.idea: 霧の窓をぬぐい、現れた野鳥の姿を写真へ残す観察遊び。
candidates.ideaEn: Wipe a fogged window and photograph the birds that emerge.

candidates.idea: 二色の粒を磁石の位置と極で集めたり散らしたりし、動く模様を標本にする庭。
candidates.ideaEn: Gather and scatter two-colored grains with movable poles, keeping a chosen pattern.

candidates.idea: 左右で違う拍を返して、波の上の船を二人でこぐ。
candidates.ideaEn: Two players echo different beats on each side to row over waves.

en.title: Two-Pole Garden
en.concept: Move two large poles and opposite-signed grains gather while matching grains move away. Flip a pole to loosen a cluster and let collisions form a new outline. With no score or correct answer, find a pleasing flow and shape and keep it as a specimen.
en.howToPlay: Drag a large magnet or tap briefly to flip its pole. Grains repel matching signs and gather at opposite signs. Keep a pattern with the bottom button when ready.
en.libraryDecision: Matter.js adds non-overlapping grains that push against one another. Field forces alone gather them into points, so collision-shaped clusters strengthen the core. Thirty-six grains and two poles keep this light; no 3D is used.
en.soundDecision: A low short tone marks grabbing, two pitches distinguish polarity flips, and a high tone marks keeping a pattern. No granular collision sounds or music interrupt watching.

aiReview.comment: 9手の画像で符号別の集まり、磁石を追う粒の塊、極を替えた反発、壁沿いから曲がる列、標本の停止と再開を確認。動かしている途中の流れは心地よいが、静止すると多くの粒が磁石の下に隠れて形を見にくい。課題や長期の変化はなく、標本もその画面内だけで永続保存はしない。

similar.title: Electric Field Hockey
similar.note: 符号を持つものの配置で動く粒の進路を変える考え方が近い。本作はゴールへ運ぶ課題ではなく、二つの極と多数の衝突する粒で形を作る遊び場。
similar.note_en: Both use signed objects to influence a moving particle's path. This is a pattern-making space with two poles and many colliding grains rather than a goal-directed hockey challenge.

similar.title: Electric Field of Dreams
similar.note: 電荷や場と粒の運動を触って観察する点が近い。本作は物理量を学ぶ表示ではなく、符号の引力・反発を簡略化した色の粒と模様の標本に絞る。
similar.note_en: Both invite interactive observation of fields, charges and motion. This uses simplified signed attraction and repulsion for colored patterns rather than displays for studying physical quantities.

aiReview.research: 2件検索し、PhET公式の電荷・場の教材とElectric Field Hockey、Electric Field of Dreamsの実在ページを確認。符号で動きを変えるルーツを比較した。Falstadの検索では具体的な作品説明を確認できず、比較には掲載しなかった。

en.comment: Nine pictured steps confirmed signed gathering, clusters following a dragged magnet, repulsion after flipping, lines bending from a wall, a frozen specimen and restart. Moving streams feel pleasant, but many settled grains hide beneath magnets, obscuring patterns. There are no tasks or long-term changes; the specimen exists only in the current screen and is not saved permanently.
en.research: Ran two searches and checked PhET's field-and-charge materials and the pages for Electric Field Hockey and Electric Field of Dreams. Compared signed-motion roots. The Falstad search did not confirm a specific work description, so it was omitted.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 9 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 9 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 大きな磁石を動かし、短いタップで極を替える説明がある。粒の庭を開く。
playLog.noteEn: The title explains dragging large magnets and tapping to flip their poles. Open the grain garden.

playLog.note: Aは＋、Bは−で、粒が格子に近く並んでいる。まず触らずに集まる動きを観察する。
playLog.noteEn: A is positive and B negative, with grains initially near a grid. Wait without touching to watch them gather.

playLog.note: 寒色がAへ、暖色がBへ集まり、多くの粒が磁石の下に隠れた。Aを右へ動かし、塊が追うか見たい。
playLog.noteEn: Cool grains gathered at A and warm grains at B, many hidden under the magnets. Drag A right to see its cluster follow.

playLog.note: Aを動かすと寒色の塊が追ってきた。Aをタップして−に替え、同符号の粒が散るか確かめる。
playLog.noteEn: The cool cluster followed A's movement. Tap A to make it negative and check that matching grains disperse.

playLog.note: AもBも−になり、寒色の粒が上の壁へ押された。Bを左下へ動かして＋に替え、寒色を呼び戻す。
playLog.noteEn: With both poles negative, cool grains were pushed against the upper wall. Move B lower-left and flip it positive to call them back.

playLog.note: 符号は替わり、暖色が右上のAへ移ったが、寒色は壁沿いに残る。Bを寒色へ近づけ、反応を見たい。
playLog.noteEn: The poles changed and warm grains moved to upper-right A, while cool grains stayed along the wall. Bring B closer to the cool grains and watch.

playLog.note: Bを近づけると寒色の列が壁から曲がり始めた。中央へ引き、粒の流れが見える途中の形を作る。
playLog.noteEn: Bringing B closer bent the cool-grain line away from the wall. Pull it toward the center to form a visible moving stream.

playLog.note: 寒色の粒が斜めの列で中央のBを追っている。この途中の模様を標本にする。
playLog.noteEn: Cool grains follow central B in a diagonal stream. Keep this in-between pattern as the specimen.

playLog.note: 模様が止まり、あなたの磁石模様と再開案内が見える。もう一度で粒と磁石が戻るか確かめる。
playLog.noteEn: The pattern is frozen with a result heading and restart prompt. Start again to check grains and magnets reset.

metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
